doc.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003

chapter: Road to New York and Maynard Ferguson
title: Maynard Ferguson band and Mark of Jazz
summary: Played a recording of Mark of Jazz; Maynard's band encouraged arranging, with Willie Maiden and Don Sebesky.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well speaking of that, I have to play something for you. Because it’s something I really think is —
You know I’d forgotten about this song.
“Mark of Jazz.” Yeah. You were writing hot licks way back then too.

Yeah. Maynard gave us a lot of opportunity to arrange and to learn about arranging. So we were inspired writing there in that band. So there were several guys that were writing a lot. Willie Maiden and Don Sebesky and a couple of other guys that were in the band. Then we were playing arrangements by great arrangers from other bands too.
Yeah it was. People really liked that band. We certainly did.
